list: Official 55-trophy list, as published by PlayStation and listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase, 2026-11-18
note: Every name, description and grade below is the official one. Every guide is written for this entry, in its own words, from the official description plus the community knowledge named in each trophy's source field. Nothing here is copied from another guide.

roadmap.summary: Just play the story in order. The chapter trophies and the named-mission trophies pop as you go, and the final mission closes the story with a gold. Do the mission-specific moments on your first run through each mission: replaying a mission is possible, but the cleanest run is the first one.
roadmap.title: Play the story, chapters 1 to 4

roadmap.summary: After the story opens the map up, work through the stranger strands and the five side characters — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each ending in a final mission of their own. Eight stranger strands finished earns the silver.
roadmap.title: Strangers and side characters

roadmap.summary: Sweep Leonida for the countable collectibles — cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots — and visit all 52 areas. Do this while you travel for other trophies so the driving never feels like a separate grind.
roadmap.title: Collectibles and the whole map

roadmap.summary: The skill grinds: gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, win drone races at all 14 spots and 20 different races, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, try all 9 activity types, pull off 250 stunts and finish 50 challenges. The Shooting Range gold is the hardest single trophy here — leave it for when your aim is warm.
roadmap.title: Activities and challenges

roadmap.summary: The wanted-level stunts with your partner, the robberies (shops, jewelry store, armored truck, bank vaults, gang operations), the money trophies and the odd one-offs. Finish with the 100% completion gold, and the platinum pops with it.
roadmap.title: Combat, chaos and clean-up

trophies.guide: The platinum is automatic: earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. There is no extra task behind it, so the real work is the roadmap — story first, then strangers, collectibles, activities and the combat clean-up. Use this tracker's progress bar to see what is left, and save the 100% completion gold (A Long Road) for last, since it is the natural final trophy before the platinum.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Follow the roadmap stages in order, top to bottom.
Tick each trophy off in this tracker as it pops, so nothing is forgotten.
Leave A Long Road (100% completion) for the end — it is the usual last trophy.
When 54 are ticked, the platinum unlocks on its own.
trophies.when: Last — it pops the moment the 54th trophy lands.

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players will earn. It is a tutorial mission: follow the on-screen prompts, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Nothing here can be missed — if you can finish the intro, you have this one.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Start a new game and play through the opening.
Follow the tutorial prompts in Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the results screen.
trophies.when: Opening mission, Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and this pops when the chapter closes. Chapters are linear, so there is no way to skip past it — just keep playing the story missions marked on the map until the chapter-ending mission is done.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story missions in Chapter 1 in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops as Chapter 1 closes.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 trophy, earned the same way as the one before it: play the story missions until the chapter ends. Chapter 2 opens more of Leonida up, so this is a good moment to start noticing side activities and stranger markers on the map — they feed the later roadmap stages.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story missions in Chapter 2 in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops as Chapter 2 closes.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's story missions and the trophy pops at the chapter close. By now the map is wide open, so if you have been putting off side content, Chapter 3 is a comfortable place to pause the story and clear a few stranger strands before pushing on.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story missions in Chapter 3 in order.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
The trophy pops as Chapter 3 closes.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: The last chapter trophy before the finale. Complete Chapter 4's story missions and it pops at the close. Missions get tougher in this chapter, so stock up on armour and ammo before the chapter's final run of missions, and use a manual save before the last one in case you want a clean retry.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story missions in Chapter 4 in order.
Stock armour and ammo before the final missions.
Complete the chapter's final mission.
trophies.when: End of Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: The story finale, and one of only two gold trophies. Complete the final mission and the gold pops. Before you start it, save the game manually: the finale is the natural point to pause and finish any story-linked clean-up, and a save here lets you replay the ending without replaying the chapter.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Finish Chapter 4 to unlock the final mission.
Make a manual save before starting it.
Complete the final mission; the gold pops at the end.
trophies.when: The final story mission, after Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission, and this trophy pops when you complete it. It is flagged missable here because it is tied to one specific mission: play it carefully on your first run rather than assuming a replay will count the same way. Follow the mission objectives, keep your partner alive if the mission asks for it, and do not skip the drive or delivery beats the mission sets up.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in the story.
Play it through on your first attempt if you can.
Complete all of the mission's objectives.
The trophy pops at the mission results screen.
trophies.when: Story mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a big set-piece story mission, and the trophy pops on completion. Heists in this series reward preparation: go in with full armour, a good rifle and a fast getaway vehicle parked nearby, and follow the crew's plan rather than improvising in the middle of the vault. Flagged missable because it belongs to this one mission — do it properly the first time.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.
Buy armour and ammo before starting.
Follow the heist plan and complete every objective.
Escape to the getaway point to finish the mission.
trophies.when: Story mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission, and the trophy pops when you finish it. Like the other named-mission trophies it is flagged missable here: it belongs to one mission, so play it through on your first run and complete every objective it gives you, including any escort or protection beat, before the mission closes.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in the story.
Complete every objective the mission sets.
Finish the mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Story mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission, and the trophy pops on completion. It is flagged missable for the same reason as the other mission trophies: one mission, one chance to do it cleanly on the first pass. Keep to the mission's objectives, and if it splits into a chase or a shootout, prioritise finishing the objective over picking fights.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in the story.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
Complete the mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Story mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the airport mission — VCIA is Vice City International Airport — and the trophy pops when you complete it. Airport missions tend to mean open ground and heavy security, so bring armour, a rifle with range, and a plan for the escape. Flagged missable because it is tied to this one mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; VCIA is Vice City International Airport per Rockstar Games' GTA VI site.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in the story.
Stock armour and a ranged weapon first.
Complete the takedown and the escape.
Finish the mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Story mission VCIA Takedown, at Vice City International Airport.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission, and the trophy pops on completion. The name suggests a big combat set-piece, so treat it like one: full armour, plenty of ammo, and a vehicle ready for the exit. It is the last of the named-mission trophies in the story run, and it is flagged missable for the same one-mission reason as the rest.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story.
Go in with full armour and ammo.
Complete every objective and finish the mission.
trophies.when: Story mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: The second gold, and the real platinum gate: reach 100% completion. In this series that means the full story, the stranger strands, the collectible sets, the activities and the miscellaneous checklist items the game tracks in its stats screen. Keep the in-game completion percentage open while you play and chase the categories that are lowest — the tracker in this guide mirrors the same list, so work through it stage by stage and this gold pops with the last item.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; 100% requirements per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands.
Complete the collectible sets and the activities.
Check the in-game stats screen for the remaining percentage.
Clear the last category to reach 100%.
trophies.when: Last — after every other requirement is done.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, airtime, near misses, drifts and long wheelies all count towards the stunt tally. This is a grind, not a skill test, so the fastest way is to fold it into normal driving: take jumps whenever you see a ramp or a raised edge, and use a fast bike for airtime. The tally accumulates across the whole game, so it will be well on its way by the time you finish the story.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; stunt types per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Use a fast bike or sports car for jumps and airtime.
Hit ramps, jumps and near misses during normal travel.
Drift corners and hold wheelies to add to the count.
Check your stats screen; the total carries across sessions.
trophies.when: Any time, after free roam opens.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in the game, and this trophy pops once you have tried each one a single time. You do not need to win or finish any of them — one attempt each is enough. The activities include the shooting range, drone racing, racing, fishing, arcade games, bowling and meditation, among others; use this guide's activity list as a checklist and tick them off as you sample each one.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; 9 activity types per the trophy list.
steps: Open the map and find the activity markers.
Try the shooting range, a race, fishing, an arcade game and bowling.
Meditate at a spot and try a drone race.
Once all 9 types are sampled, the trophy pops.
trophies.when: Any time after the activities unlock.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game for most players: gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own par score, so the method is the same every time — learn the course, then run it clean. Use a weapon you are comfortable with, aim for the head and centre rings, and reload during movement rather than standing still. If a challenge keeps beating you, leave it and come back after practising the same weapon in free roam; your accuracy, not your speed, is what the gold score rewards.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; 42 challenges per the trophy list.
steps: Find a shooting range on the map.
Play each challenge and learn its target layout.
Aim for head and centre-ring hits; reload while moving.
Gold all 42 challenges — the tally is tracked per challenge.
trophies.when: Any time; save it for when your aim is warm.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations across Leonida, and this trophy needs a win at every one of them. Drone racing is about smooth lines, not top speed: cut the gates cleanly, avoid the crash-and-respawn penalty, and learn each course's turns on a practice run before going for the win. The locations are spread across the state, so combine the trips with the exploration and collectible runs.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; 14 locations per the trophy list.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race marker.
Learn the course with a slow, clean run first.
Race again and win; repeat at all 14 locations.
The trophy pops after the 14th location's win.
trophies.when: Any time after drone races unlock.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses, not the same race twenty times. Street races, off-road races and any other race type all count, as long as each course is a new one. Pick a car that suits the course: a grippy sports car for street circuits, something tougher for off-road. Winning early races is easy; the count is the grind, so work through the race markers across the map rather than replaying your favourite.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Find race markers across the map.
Pick a car suited to each course.
Win the race; each new course adds one to the count.
Reach 20 different race wins.
trophies.when: Any time after racing unlocks.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is your fishing rival, and this trophy pops when you beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing in this series is a patience mini-game: watch the line tension, reel steadily, and do not yank when the fish runs. If you lose to Cal, you can challenge him again — this is a skill check, not a one-time event, so keep practising the reeling rhythm until you out-fish him.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; fishing method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Find a fishing spot and take the challenge against Cal.
Keep the line tension in the safe zone while reeling.
Let the fish run when it pulls hard, then reel again.
Beat Cal's catch to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Any time after fishing unlocks.

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine and finish a game on it — one full playthrough of any arcade game is all it takes. Arcade games are short, so pick whichever machine looks easiest, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through to the end screen. It counts on completion, not on a high score, so there is no pressure to be good at it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Find an arcade machine in Vice City.
Pick any game and start a playthrough.
Play it through to the end screen.
The trophy pops on completion.
trophies.when: Any time after the arcade is open.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the five side characters with their own mission strand, and this trophy pops when you finish his last mission. Side strands unlock as the story progresses, so if Andy's missions are not showing yet, keep playing the story. Work through his strand in order; the final mission is marked like any other, and the trophy pops at its end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story until Andy's strand appears.
Complete Andy's missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Side strand — Andy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is another of the five side characters, and this trophy pops on his final mission. Like Andy's strand, his missions appear as the story advances — play the story to unlock them, then follow the strand to its end. His final mission involves a boat, judging by the name, so be ready for a water escape when you reach it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story until Kenton's strand appears.
Complete Kenton's missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Side strand — Kenton's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy is one of the five side characters with a mission strand, and this trophy pops when his final mission is done. His strand is the rider-themed one, so expect bikes and open-road missions along the way. Complete his missions in order and the trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story until Billy's strand appears.
Complete Billy's missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Side strand — Billy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers are the question-mark characters scattered across Leonida, each with a short mission strand of their own. This silver needs 8 strands completed, and the five side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are separate trophies — these 8 are the other strangers. Check the map for stranger markers whenever you are in a new area, and do a strand as soon as you find it rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Watch for stranger markers on the map in each area.
Start a strand and complete all of its missions.
Repeat for 8 different strangers.
The silver pops after the 8th strand is finished.
trophies.when: Across the whole game; do strands as you find them.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy is one of the five side characters, and this trophy pops on his final mission. His strand is the supply-themed one, so expect delivery and pickup missions on the way. Play the story to unlock his strand, work through it in order, and the trophy pops when the last mission ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story until Randy's strand appears.
Complete Randy's missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Side strand — Randy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone is the last of the five side characters, and this trophy pops on his final mission. His strand is the one with the spinning, showy style the name hints at. Unlock his missions through the story, complete the strand in order, and the trophy pops at the end of his final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play the story until Tyrone's strand appears.
Complete Tyrone's missions in order.
Finish his final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Side strand — Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and this trophy needs all of them. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places — hilltops, beaches, quiet clearings — and each one is a short interaction. They are worth finding while you are exploring for the 52 areas anyway: when you reach a new region, check for a meditation marker before you leave it.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; 18 spots per the trophy list.
steps: Look for meditation markers while exploring each region.
Interact at the spot and complete the meditation.
Repeat at all 18 spots across Leonida.
The trophy pops after the 18th spot.
trophies.when: Any time; combine with the 52-area exploration.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret wants a unique animal hunted, and this trophy pops when you bring it down. Unique animals are one-of-a-kind hunts: track the animal in its habitat, approach quietly, and take a clean shot. Use a scoped rifle, stay downwind, and save before the final approach so a missed shot does not cost you the hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; hunting method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Take Bret's hunt and find the animal's habitat.
Track it quietly with a scoped rifle.
Take a clean shot and confirm the kill.
Return to Bret to finish the hunt.
trophies.when: Side hunt for Bret, after it unlocks.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are scattered across Leonida in sets, and this silver needs 3 full sets completed. Cards hide in shops, bars, garages and other interiors as well as out in the world, so search inside buildings, not just on the streets. Pick one set and chase it to completion before starting another — a finished set is progress, a half-finished one is not.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Find cards in interiors and across the map.
Collect every card in one set.
Complete 3 full sets.
The silver pops after the 3rd set is complete.
trophies.when: Any time; combine with exploration.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the in-game photo-sharing activity, and this silver needs 100 locations photographed with it. The method is simple and the count is the grind: open WAiNK at a named location, snap it, and move on. The smart way is to do it while you explore the 52 areas for The Goodtime State — photograph each area as you arrive, and the two trophies progress together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; WAiNK method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Open the WAiNK activity at a location.
Take the photo to register the location.
Repeat at new locations across Leonida.
Reach 100 WAiNK locations for the silver.
trophies.when: Any time; do it while exploring the 52 areas.

trophies.guide: The game tracks a set of challenges — small feats across driving, combat, exploration and activities — and this trophy needs 50 of them completed. Challenges overlap heavily with the other trophies: stunts, races, collectibles and robberies all feed the challenge list, so do not chase this one directly at first. Open the challenges menu late in the game, see which 50 are closest, and mop up the easy ones that are left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Play normally; challenges complete as you go.
Open the challenges menu to see your progress.
Pick the nearest unfinished challenges.
Complete 50 in total to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Late game, after most other trophies are done.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Four stars means helicopters and roadblocks, so do not try this in downtown traffic: earn the stars in a quieter area, then drive fast and off-road to break line of sight, and use the map edge or a tunnel to let the wanted level cool. Your partner must be with you when the stars clear, so do not leave them behind in the chase.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; escape method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Bring your partner along and earn a 4-star wanted level.
Drive away from the search area fast.
Break line of sight — off-road, tunnels or the map edge help.
When the stars clear with your partner present, the trophy pops.
trophies.when: Any time with your partner, after free roam opens.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — the streak breaks if the stars clear between robberies. Plan a route of three close shops first, use a fast car, and keep each robbery quick: in, take the money, out, and straight to the next shop. Do not stop to fight the police; the wanted level must survive, but so must you.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Pick three shops close together and plan the route.
Bring your partner and a fast car.
Rob the first shop, then drive straight to the next.
Rob all three without the wanted level clearing.
trophies.when: Any time with your partner; plan the route first.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive them, and they count. Every new car, bike, boat or truck you get into adds to the total, so this one grows naturally as you explore. To speed it up, visit car parks, dealerships and busy streets and hop into anything you have not driven yet; the discovery list in the stats screen shows what you still need.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Get into any vehicle you have not driven before.
Check the discovery list in the stats screen.
Visit car parks, dealerships and busy areas.
Reach 100 different vehicles discovered.
trophies.when: Any time; grows naturally while you play.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode, and this trophy needs 5 enemies downed in one single use of it. The trick is to set the scene first: find a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them quickly while time is slowed. A busy shootout with enemies clustered together is ideal — do not waste the focus on a single straggler.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Combat Focus method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus.
Down 5 enemies before the focus ends.
The trophy pops on the 5th takedown.
trophies.when: Any combat-heavy mission or shootout.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: VCIA is Vice City International Airport, and this trophy is about leaving it in a way no timetable allows — take a plane (or another aircraft) and depart without a schedule. Get onto the airfield, board an aircraft, and take off. Airport security will notice, so be ready to move fast and do not linger on the runway.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; VCIA is Vice City International Airport per Rockstar Games' GTA VI site.
steps: Get to Vice City International Airport.
Reach the airfield and board an aircraft.
Take off without a schedule.
The trophy pops on your unscheduled departure.
trophies.when: Any time the airport is accessible.

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks, and this trophy is about dealing with them — surviving the heat they bring. Expect Rhinos to show up at high wanted levels or in military areas: keep your distance, use cover, and use heavy weapons or explosives rather than small arms. The description is deliberately vague, so the practical reading is to take on a Rhino encounter and come out of it alive.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Rhino method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Reach a high wanted level or a military area to draw a Rhino.
Use heavy weapons or explosives, not small arms.
Use cover and keep moving.
Survive the Rhino encounter to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: High wanted level or military areas.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A stealth robbery: rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. This is the quietest trophy in the clean-up stage, and it rewards patience over speed. Case the store first, go in when it is quiet, move slowly, take the goods without tripping alarms, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — leave and try again later.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; stealth method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its routine.
Go in quietly and avoid the staff's sightlines.
Take the goods without tripping alarms.
Leave undetected to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Any time; try it when the store is quiet.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape from each one — the silver of the robbery set. Bank vaults are the biggest jobs outside the story heists: each one needs a plan, a crew approach and a getaway. Do them one at a time, with a fast car parked nearby and a route out of the area already in mind. Five escapes is the count; there is no requirement to do them in one run.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Find a bank vault robbery opportunity.
Plan the getaway car and route before going in.
Rob the vault and escape the police.
Repeat for 5 vaults to earn the silver.
trophies.when: Late game, when vault jobs are available.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the money and escape. Armored trucks travel set routes, so watch for one, block it with your car, deal with the guards, crack it open and get out before the police response builds. A fast getaway car is more important than firepower here — the escape is the part that counts.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Spot an armored truck on its route.
Block it and deal with the guards.
Take the money from the truck.
Escape the police to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Any time armored trucks are on the road.

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida — every named district, town and stretch of countryside on the map. The game tracks each area as you enter it, so the method is simply to travel: drive the highways, take the back roads, and visit the islands and the rural north as well as Vice City itself. Combine this with the meditation spots and the WAiNK photos so one trip covers three trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; 52 areas per the trophy list.
steps: Open the map and note the areas you have not visited.
Drive through each unvisited area.
Check the stats screen for the areas still missing.
Visit all 52 areas to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Any time; combine with meditation and WAiNK.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs in Leonida, each running illegal operations, and this trophy needs one operation robbed from each of the 9. Gangs own different turf, so this is a map-wide job: find each gang's operation, hit it, and move on to the next gang's territory. Expect a fight at each one, and do not hit the same gang twice — the count needs all 9 gangs, not 9 robberies.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; 9 gangs per the trophy list.
steps: Learn which gang controls each area.
Find an illegal operation on a gang's turf.
Rob it and escape.
Repeat for all 9 gangs.
trophies.when: Late game, once gang turf is known.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City, find a bar with a view of the water, and enjoy a cocktail there. This is one of the simplest trophies in the game — no skill, no grind, just the right place and the right drink. Do it on a clear in-game evening if you want the view at its best.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; Ocean Beach per Rockstar Games' GTA VI site.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Find a bar with a view of the water.
Order and enjoy a cocktail there.
The trophy pops when the drink is served.
trophies.when: Any time Ocean Beach is open.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get into a vehicle inside a showroom and smash your way out through the glass, in the classic style the series is famous for. Pick a showroom, get into a car on the floor, and drive straight out through the front window. The trophy is about the exit, so do not stop for the door — the glass is the point.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Get into a car on the showroom floor.
Drive straight out through the front glass.
The trophy pops on the smash exit.
trophies.when: Any time a showroom is open.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — follow through on the lane, as the description puts it. Play a game of bowling there; you do not need a high score, just a full game at this specific alley. It is a gentle trophy and a good one to pair with the arcade and the other Vice City activities.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Find the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Start a game of bowling.
Play it through to the end.
The trophy pops when the game finishes.
trophies.when: Any time the bowling alley is open.

trophies.guide: Build your partnership's appeal with the public — the in-game social audience — until it reaches mass appeal. In practice this means doing things together with your partner that the in-game public notices: shared activities, public appearances and the social feed. Keep playing the partner activities and the following grows; the trophy pops when the partnership's appeal crosses the threshold.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; social method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Play activities together with your partner.
Build the partnership's public following.
Keep going until the appeal reaches mass level.
The trophy pops at the threshold.
trophies.when: Across the game, with your partner.

trophies.guide: Make choices — the game tracks them, with a count running to 500. Choices appear in missions, conversations and side content: pick one option or the other whenever the game asks. This is a long count, so do not chase it directly; make choices naturally as you play and it will climb. It is flagged missable only because some choices exist once and cannot be remade — take the choice when it is offered.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; count of 500 per the trophy list.
steps: Take the choices the game offers in missions and conversations.
Each choice adds to the tracked count.
Keep choosing as you play through the game.
Reach the count of 500 to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Across the whole game.

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something once, then succeed at it the next time. The simplest way is to pick a small, repeatable challenge you can fail on purpose: fail it once, then pass it. If you are the kind of player who aces everything first time, this one is easy to miss, which is why it is flagged — deliberately fail a retryable event once, then succeed, and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Pick a small repeatable challenge.
Fail it once on purpose.
Try it again and succeed.
The trophy pops on the second-try success.
trophies.when: Any time, on a retryable event.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the game's odd, unexplained event. Strange happenings in this series tend to occur at specific places and times, often at night or in remote spots, and they are easy to walk past without noticing. Explore the odd corners of the map, keep an eye out for anything that does not fit, and the trophy pops when you see it. It is flagged missable because a one-off strange event can be missed if you are not looking.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; event method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Explore remote and unusual spots, especially at night.
Watch for anything strange or out of place.
Trigger or witness the event.
The trophy pops when you see it happen.
trophies.when: Any time, in the stranger corners of Leonida.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — hit a pedestrian with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a target, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and connect. It is a timing trick more than a fight: a slow pass and a well-timed swing is all it takes, and a quiet street makes it easier than a busy one.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; method per GTA Wiki community guides.
steps: Equip a melee weapon and get into a vehicle.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian.
Swing the melee weapon from the vehicle.
Knock them down to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Any time, on a quiet street.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies, and laundering them through your contacts turns them clean — this trophy needs $250,000 laundered in total. Robberies are the source of Marked Bills, so this trophy follows naturally from the robbery trophies: rob, launder the take through a contact, and repeat. The total accumulates across the whole game, so keep laundering every take rather than letting bills pile up.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from robberies.
Take them to a contact to launder.
Repeat after each robbery.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.
trophies.when: After robberies, across the game.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — weapons, clothes, cars, food, anything the shops sell. This is a pure spending total, so it grows as you gear up for the other trophies: buy armour and ammo for the missions, buy cars for the races, and the total climbs. If you are short at the end, the fastest top-up is an expensive car or a wardrobe splurge.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Buy weapons, armour and ammo as you play.
Buy cars, clothes and upgrades.
Check the spending total in the stats screen.
Reach $100,000 spent across all shops.
trophies.when: Across the whole game; top up with a big purchase at the end.

trophies.guide: There are 8 garage properties to buy across Leonida, and this trophy needs all of them. Garages are bought like other properties: find the for-sale sign, pay the price, and the garage is yours. They are also useful — each one is a safe place to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good, so buy them as you travel rather than leaving them all for the end.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase; 8 garages per the trophy list.
steps: Find garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy each one when you have the money.
Keep a list of the ones you own.
Purchase all 8 garages to pop the trophy.
trophies.when: Any time; buy them as you travel.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lets you register vehicles, and this trophy needs 10 of them registered. Find vehicles you own or have discovered, open the app, and register them one by one. Ten is a small count — pair this with the 100-vehicle discovery trophy and register the first ten you find.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.source: Official description — PlayStation trophy list via PSNProfiles / Exophase.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app.
Register a vehicle you have discovered.
Repeat for 10 different vehicles.
The trophy pops on the 10th registration.
trophies.when: Any time after the app is available.
